scenarios.title: A permanent with living metal is a creature only during its controller's turn

setup.notes: Goldbug is on the battlefield converted (its back face Goldbug, Scrappy Scout, a 1/3 Vehicle with living metal, face up). It has been under A's control since earlier turns and is untapped. No crew is paid.

decisions: No spells or abilities are used. The permanent's types are read in the first main phase.

variants.label: own_turn
variants.expected: During A's turn Goldbug, Scrappy Scout is a legendary artifact creature Vehicle with power and toughness 1/3. It is a legal attacker.

variants.label: opponent_turn
variants.delta: It is B's turn (B is the active player) instead of A's.
variants.expected: During B's turn Goldbug, Scrappy Scout is only a legendary artifact Vehicle, not a creature, since it is not crewed. It is not a creature and cannot block.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge stores the Vehicle face as the alternate state of the card named Goldbug, Humanity's Ally.
